body:
Improve discovery and onboarding for released spawn, refresh and handoff.

Owner: ecochran76. State: IN_PROGRESS. Branch: docs/lifecycle-onboarding.
Plan: docs/dev/plans/0163-2026-10-14-lifecycle-onboarding.md.
Depends on integrated P156/P162. No active overlaps or blockers.

Observed on 0.15.1: README says 15 tools (actual 19), lifecycle guide and
installed skill retain obsolete candidate/pending language, and operation choice
and request templates are hard to find.

Acceptance: README chooser; CLI/MCP templates checked against current interfaces;
accurate release evidence boundaries; clear host setup, checkpoint and resource
requirements; installed skill parity. Documentation only, no runtime behavior,
paid native turns or shared service restart. Integration/deployment are separate.

<!-- codex-wake-p163-lifecycle-onboarding -->
title: Make released agent lifecycle operations discoverable and easy to use
